verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe fine-grained reactivity: automatic dependency tracking (solid-gh-10), state changes causing only dependent code to rerun (solid-gh-1), and a render-once model where components are just functions (solid-gh-9, solid-gh-14). This is corroborated by hands-on community reports praising the granular, intuitive reactivity and performance (solid-comm-7, solid-comm-10, solid-comm-19). Missing for 10: independent benchmark/technical deep-dive isolating this exact fine-grained update mechanism beyond anecdotal praise.
